CSM Owns: Use-case scoping, running the demonstration session, capturing the outcome with the customer
Artifact Produced: Before/after measurement on one workflow the customer already runs, plus one number they agree with
Definition of Done: The customer states the result in their own words, unprompted, to someone else in their org
First Three Moves: 1. Identify the one existing workflow with the most manual downstream work — ask the team, don't guess. 2. Pull Solutions in to build a narrow AI version of exactly that workflow, nothing adjacent. 3. Book a 30-min session where the team runs it themselves, and capture the before/after number live.

CSM Owns: Sponsor mapping, executive re-engagement, the charter conversation
Artifact Produced: Named executive owner, a written charter with one outcome and a date, and at least 3 mapped threads
Definition of Done: The new sponsor commits — in writing or in front of their peers — to a named outcome and a date
First Three Moves: 1. Map every remaining relationship and identify who inherited the departed champion's scope. 2. Use the one working pilot as the proof asset — sponsorship is easier to recruit for something real than for a roadmap. 3. Bring the AE in to open at the level above the vacancy, not at the vacancy.

CSM Owns: User-layer discovery, negotiating success criteria with the people who will actually use it
Artifact Produced: Success criteria written by the user-side lead, in their words, not ours
Definition of Done: The skeptical team's lead publicly commits to the success criteria in front of their exec
First Three Moves: 1. Book 45 minutes with the skeptical ops lead alone, before kickoff, and ask what the last two tools did to them. 2. Rewrite the kickoff agenda around one workflow that removes work from that team — cut the vision session. 3. Have the ops lead, not us, present the success criteria to the COO at kickoff.

CSM Owns: Baseline and current measurement, the narrative, the executive readout
Artifact Produced: Value story in the economic buyer's language plus a traceable evidence pack
Definition of Done: The economic buyer repeats the number back to us
First Three Moves: 1. 45-min working session with the champion to baseline the production workflow — volume, time, headcount. 2. Pull Value Eng in to validate the conversion before anything is written down. 3. Get the champion to confirm the numbers before the CFO's office or procurement ever sees them.

CSM Owns: The relationship with the review board, sequencing, keeping the sponsor warm while it takes time
Artifact Produced: AI risk and controls pack, reference architecture, and answers to the board's stated objections
Definition of Done: The review board approves at least one use case
First Three Moves: 1. Ask the sponsor to get us 30 minutes with the review board directly — stop relaying. 2. Get the board's actual evaluation criteria in writing; most of what we are guessing at is written down somewhere. 3. Bring Trust & Security in to build against those criteria specifically, not a generic security packet.

CSM Owns: The standards proposal, executive re-entry, reframing what CS is for
Artifact Produced: Agent inventory, a governance standard the customer adopts, and a cost and sprawl view
Definition of Done: The customer adopts the standard and CS is in the build path for new agents
First Three Moves: 1. Offer a free agent inventory — they already know they have agents nobody owns. 2. Come back with a sprawl and cost view, which is the thing they cannot produce themselves. 3. Propose a lightweight standard they own and we review, then use that seat to re-enter at exec level before pricing.

CSM Owns: The internal referral motion, seeding a CoE, second-team onboarding
Artifact Produced: CoE charter and a second team in production
Definition of Done: A second business unit or team has an AI workflow running in production
First Three Moves: 1. Ask the successful champion to introduce us to one peer — internal referral beats our outreach every time. 2. Package what the first team built as a reusable pattern, not a bespoke build. 3. Propose a standing cross-team forum and let the original champion chair it.

CSM Owns: Running the review with the customer and the AE
Artifact Produced: Dated value story plus a written expansion hypothesis
Definition of Done: Zero surprises at the renewal — nothing raised in the renewal conversation is new information
First Three Moves: 1. Confirm the value story is customer-validated, not just drafted — if it isn't, that is the whole play. 2. Run a joint session with the AE 2 quarters out, not 2 weeks out. 3. Ask the sponsor directly what would make them not renew, and write down the answer.
